understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked '+'; with multiple goals, all goals had to be occupied simultaneously to win the level and complete the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls blocked movement and adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when space allowed. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by CLICKing their exact pixel/grid coordinates; movement applied only to the currently selected piece. The blocked indicators were hints rather than absolute guarantees, so movement had to be tested.
